_om: Terninga in English (Dicey, rusj.no/en/dicey/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Scandinavian scoring (pairs, a 50-point bonus at 63, Yatzy = five of a kind) – the game says so in its intro; the other company's name for the game is only in sok. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
The sum of all the ones.
The sum of all the twos.
The sum of all the threes.
The sum of all the fours.
The sum of all the fives.
The sum of all the sixes.
Two the same. The highest pair counts.
The sum of the three matching dice.
The sum of the four matching dice.
The sum of the five matching dice.
Tre like og to like av et annet tall. Su: Three of one number and two of another. Scores their sum.
Two sets of three of a kind. Scores the sum of all six.
Fire like og to like av et annet tall. S: Four of one number and two of another. Scores the sum of all six.
The sum of all the dice.
{felt}: gir 0 – trykk for å stryke: {felt}: scores 0 – tap to cross it out
You have three rolls this round.
{navn} velger hvilke terninger som skal: {navn} is choosing which dice to hold …
Trykk på terningene du vil holde: Tap the dice you want to hold
Velg et felt på blokka: Pick a box on the scorecard
Hva feltene gir med seks terninger: What each box scores with six dice
Summen av terningene med det tallet. {gr: The sum of the dice showing that number. {grense} or more in total earns a bonus of {bonus}.
Kast du ikke bruker, spares til senere t: Rolls you don't use are saved for later turns.
Kast terningene opptil tre ganger og fyl: Roll the dice up to three times and fill in the scorecard – Scandinavian style, with pairs and a 50-point bonus. Most points wins.
Du har tre kast hver tur. Trykk på terni: You get three rolls each turn. Tap the dice you want to keep, and roll the rest again.
Blokka viser hva hvert ledig felt gir. T: The scorecard shows what every open box would score. Tap one – you must fill a box every turn, even if it scores 0.
Når blokka er full, er spillet over. 63: When the scorecard is full, the game is over. 63 points or more on ones to sixes earns a 50-point bonus (with six dice: 84 earns 100).
I vanlig Yatzy gir tre av hver på enere–: With five dice, three of each on ones to sixes makes exactly 63 – and the bonus. With six dice you need four of each (84).
To par må være to ulike tall. Hus er tre: Two pairs must be two different numbers. A full house is three of one number and two of another.
Trykket på feil felt? «Angre» tar det ti: Tapped the wrong box? ‘Undo’ takes it back, right up to the next roll.
Med seks terninger er det 20 felt – og k: With six dice there are 20 boxes – and any rolls you don't use are saved for later.
Hvor mange spillere mobilen er: How many players the phone is
beholder det opplagte og bommer av og ti: keeps the obvious dice and slips up now and then
spiller fornuftig og passer på bonusen: plays sensibly and keeps an eye on the bonus
Legg til en motspiller som mobilen styre: Add an opponent played by the phone.
20 felt · spar kast du ikke bruker: 20 boxes · save rolls you don't use
Pass the phone on after every turn.
Alene? Jakt på din egen rekord – eller s: On your own? Chase your own record – or play against the phone.
Blokka ble ikke full denne gangen. Fyll: The scorecard wasn't filled this time. Fill it all in to set a record!
Første runde på denne mobilen – nå har d: Your first game on this phone – now you've got a record to beat!

{n} poeng – mobilen vant denne gangen. R.one: {n} point – the phone won this time. Rematch?
{n} poeng – mobilen vant denne gangen. R.other: {n} points – the phone won this time. Rematch?
